title: Generic
summary: A general-purpose agent for its organization. It researches, analyzes, writes, builds and converts files, runs scheduled work, and keeps its own memory.
_gcp_roles_comment: The agent's base set, granted on the project to paraclete-agent@ by the installer for every instance, since every instance gets the generic role. Vertex AI, Firestore, logs and metrics. Two grants are deliberately not here because they are not project roles: the instance bucket (roles/storage.objectAdmin on that bucket only, made where the installer creates the bucket) and secrets (roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on each secret a dashboard admin grants). Drive comes from the VM's access scopes, not IAM. No project-wide admin role.
_setup_comment: Installed on every instance by install/bootstrap.sh with apt-get, without recommended packages, so the list names everything the tools need: patch, python3-dev and build-essential are what git and python3-pip used to bring along as recommendations. The rest is the file toolchain the files skill runs: pandoc; poppler-utils (pdftotext, pdfinfo, pdftoppm) with poppler-data, for PDFs in Chinese, Japanese or Korean; qpdf; LibreOffice without its desktop (soffice --headless) for Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with libreoffice-math-nogui so equations survive a conversion; chromium (--headless=new); two font families; the Python libraries for Word, Excel and PDF, with python3-pil for the images in them and python3-pycryptodome for encrypted PDFs; imagemagick (convert); and file.
